answer: We define a cryptoeconomic mechanism where validators distributed from a limestone karst to a coastal dune lock staking collateral, anchored by a hardware relic executing zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. If an adversary attempts Sybil multiplication, the subgame-perfect slashing matrix enforces a penalty exceeding the collateral. Consequently, the expected utility of the attack becomes strictly negative, ensuring a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation remains the dominant strategy.
